name: OTPField
summary: A one time code shown in separate cells: one native input holds the code, the cells draw it.
useWhen: A verification code sent by text message or email, usually 4 to 8 digits
A pairing code shown on another device
A backup code of letters and digits with a fixed length
avoidWhen: A password or a passphrase the person made up
A value with no fixed length, such as an amount or an order number
A phone number, a card number or a date

length.description: Number of cells and characters in a full code.

groups.description: Group sizes, for a separator between groups: [3, 3] shows 123 456. Ignored when they do not add up to length.

charset.description: numeric: digits and the number keypad. alphanumeric: Latin letters, upper cased, and digits.

onValueChange.description: Called with the parsed code each time it changes.

onComplete.description: Called each time the code becomes a new full code: the last cell typed, a paste, an autofill, or one cell of a full code changed.

size.description: Cell height and width from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density.

shape.description: default takes radius.field from the style. pill draws round cells.

invalid.description: Marks the code invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Still focusable and readable. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

required.description: Sets aria-required. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

autoComplete.description: Lets the SMS autofill of iOS and Android and password managers fill the code.

rootProps.description: Props for the root. className and style also go to the root; every other native prop and the ref go to the input.

a11y.role: textbox, from the one native input. The cells and separators are aria-hidden drawings of its value.
a11y.focus: The input is the only tab stop. Tab lands on the first empty cell, or the last cell of a full code. A click picks the cell under the pointer. The active cell shows the glow and a 2px ring.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the code, and on to the next control
keys.ArrowLeft, ArrowRight: Move one cell back or on. The cells run left to right in every language, so ArrowLeft is always the previous cell: inside the left to right group the physical direction is the reading direction
keys.Home, End: Move to the first cell, or to the first empty cell
keys.Shift+ArrowLeft, Shift+ArrowRight: Extend the selection over several cells, as in any text field
keys.Backspace: Clears the active cell, the cells after it move back one place, and the cell before it becomes active
keys.Delete: Clears the active cell; the cells after it move back

a11y.announce: One name for the whole code, from the Field label or aria-label. The Field description and error through aria-describedby. The value reads as the code.
notes: One input, not one per cell: the SMS autofill of iOS and Android and password managers fill one field with the whole code, a paste lands in one field, and a screen reader meets one named field instead of six unnamed boxes. This keeps paste and autofill working (WCAG 2.2, 3.3.8 accessible authentication).
Paste is never blocked. A paste replaces the whole code. Spaces, dashes and Arabic Indic digits are read, and the one code in a pasted SMS sentence is found (parseCode in @the-system/shared).
autocomplete one-time-code and inputmode numeric are set; the number keypad opens on phones. The input uses a 16px font, so phones do not zoom on focus.
No maxlength: a pasted code with spaces would be cut before it is read. The code is cut to length after it is read.
The root has dir ltr: a code reads left to right in Arabic too, like a phone number.
Check the code when onComplete fires, and say the result in the Field error or description. Never clear the code on an error: the person may want to fix one digit.
Do not put a time limit on entry without a way to ask for a new code (WCAG 2.2.1).

en.label: A noun in sentence case: Verification code, Pairing code, Backup code. One label for the whole field.
en.description: Where the code was sent, and how long it lasts: We sent a 6 digit code to the number ending in 1234.
en.error: What happened and what to do: This code has expired. Send a new code and enter it here.

ar.label: رمز التحقق، رمز الربط، الرمز الاحتياطي
ar.description: وين وصل الرمز وكم مدته، بالأرقام اللاتينية
ar.error: وش صار ووش يسوي: الرمز انتهت صلاحيته، اطلب رمز جديد

react.behavior: hand built on one native input (Radix One Time Password Field is Preview)

styles.studio: Square cells with the field radius and the control border; the active cell takes the soft glow and the 2px achromatic ring
styles.desk: The same cells and ring, digits in Instrument Sans with tabular figures

mistakes.wrong: Six separate inputs, one per digit
mistakes.right: One OTPField: autofill, paste and screen readers see one field

mistakes.wrong: Blocking paste or autofill on the code
mistakes.right: Leave both on; OTPField reads spaces, dashes and SMS text

mistakes.wrong: A label on each cell, or no label
mistakes.right: One Field label for the whole code

mistakes.wrong: Cells that run right to left in an Arabic form
mistakes.right: OTPField keeps the code left to right through dir ltr on the root

mistakes.wrong: Clearing the code when it is wrong
mistakes.right: Keep it, mark the Field invalid and say what to do
